claim: Saves a local HTML receipt when a wrapped Playwright assertion fails and lets the test flow continue.
sandbox: bundled Playwright fixture; intentional assertion failure; assert one local receipt and continued page state

claim: Removes form and configured-selector values and names from DOM and accessibility evidence.
sandbox: fresh packed consumer; assert short form, label, ARIA, description, and configured-selector markers are absent

claim: Masks form fields, visible labels, and elements matched by configured selectors in receipt screenshot pixels.
sandbox: fresh packed consumer with bright private regions; decode the embedded PNG and assert their center pixels equal the opaque mask color

claim: Includes recent browser warnings and errors in the receipt.
sandbox: fresh packed consumer; emit a unique browser warning before failure and assert the generated receipt contains it

claim: Network rows contain method, status, type, redacted URL shape, and duration without bodies, headers, queries, fragments, credentials, or path values.
sandbox: fresh packed consumer; send unique body, header, path, query, and fragment markers; assert none persist while every promised metadata field does

claim: Each HTML receipt includes the test, project, capture time, redacted page URL, and assertion failure.
sandbox: fresh packed consumer; parse one generated receipt and validate every context field and timestamp

claim: Receipt creation does not upload the file or send telemetry.
sandbox: fresh packed consumer; block and record browser requests plus Node fetch, HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, and TLS calls during receipt creation; require every log to remain empty

claim: Requires and supports Node 20 or later.
sandbox: bundled Node 20.19.5 binary; typecheck, unit test, build, and load ESM and CommonJS package entry points

claim: The documented receipt limits, output path, selectors, and screenshot settings are the package defaults.
sandbox: call the exported option resolver with no input and compare its observable result with every documented default

claim: Creates a sample failure receipt from editable bundled input.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo/?demo=1; edit label and assert rendered receipt

claim: Masks the private sample field in the demo receipt.
sandbox: fresh browser context; enter a unique private marker and assert it is absent from receipt output

claim: Demo data uses a demo: browser-storage namespace and Reset demo restores bundled sample data.
sandbox: fresh browser context; mutate demo, reset, and assert real namespace is unchanged

claim: The documentation and demo make only same-origin requests, run no analytics, and set no cookies during the sample flow.
sandbox: fresh browser context; intercept every request through receipt creation and inspect cookies and loaded scripts

claim: The demo works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; activate service worker, set offline, reload /demo/, edit input, and create a receipt
